title: Casa Piedra: Oceanfront House.

description: One of the most calm and romantic houses available in Rincon, Puerto Rico. Watch the dawn and/or sunset over the ocean from the terrace or without leaving your bed. Swim laps in the pool or out to the reef in front of the house. Casa Piedra is close enough to everything, but private enough to be in your own world. Ask about massages on-site while listening to the waves, and many other options.The spaceWelcome to Your Seaside SanctuaryWelcome to Casa Piedra, Your Seaside Sanctuary!Nestled in the tranquil southern part of Rincon, Casa Piedra offers a unique blend of serene coastal living and convenient access to the vibrant heart of town. Owned by an American who has embraced island life alongside his French wife, this home has been lovingly restored with local stone, reflecting both its heritage and the natural beauty of its surroundings.Luxurious Comforts in a Breathtaking Setting:Our two-bedroom retreat faces the ocean, allowing you to wake up to the soothing sounds of the waves. First bedroom with a queen size bed and second bedroom with a queen size bed ans a twin bed. Each room offers stunning views and direct access to a covered terrace, perfect for savoring your morning coffee or watching the sunset. The house features two full bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a spacious living/dining area. Whether you're lounging in the airy salon or enjoying the covered terrace, every moment here speaks of relaxation and comfort.Exclusive Amenities:Beach Access: Step directly onto a secluded beach with a vibrant reef and an array of marine life. Enjoy the ultimate privacy.Lap Pool: Dive into our lap pool, a legacy from the home’s past owner, a celebrated Puerto Rican athlete.Eco-Friendly Features: Designed for comfort and peace of mind, Casa Piedra offers premium infrastructure, including an 8,000+ gallon water cistern, solar energy with two Tesla battery storage, and a generac backup generator. Guests can enjoy uninterrupted modern comforts and a worry-free stay while taking in the beauty of the Caribbean. We ensure your comfort during infrequent outages. Live Like a Local with Tailored Experiences:Enhance your stay with our bespoke services. We can organize in-house massages, private yoga sessions, and the culinary delights of a private chef, all without leaving the comfort of Casa Piedra.Your Hosts Nearby:Having lived in Casa Piedra for the past two years, we've now moved next door, allowing us to offer this beautiful space to you while remaining close by to ensure your stay is perfect. Managed by my wife Salome, along with a dedicated team that includes a full-time manager and regular cleaner, we're here to make sure your holiday is seamless and memorable.Special Introductory Rate:As new hosts on Airbnb, we're offering Casa Piedra at a special rate, significantly lower than its historical rental price of $1000/night, as we aim to build our reputation. Come experience this hidden gem for yourself!Book Your Stay at Casa Piedra:Immerse yourself in the charm and elegance of this seaside retreat. Whether seeking a peaceful escape or an adventurous exploration, Casa Piedra promises a vacation you'll cherish. Don't miss out on this perfect blend of luxury and comfort. Book your stay with us today and make memories that last a lifetime by the sea!Guest accessFlexible Check-In: We understand that travel plans can vary, so we aim to be as accommodating as possible. Our standard check-in time is from 3 PM onwards, but we are flexible and can arrange earlier or later check-ins if needed. Please let us know in advance so we can prepare everything for your arrival.Our standard check-out time is before 11pm. Easy and Convenient Access: To make your arrival and stay as comfortable as possible, we offer a private parking area with two spots reserved exclusively for our guests. Enjoy this convenient access at any time during your stay at Casa Piedra.

description: Romantic ocean view studio perched in the hills of Rincón. Featuring a wraparound corner terrace and floor-to-ceiling glass with breathtaking panoramic views of the Caribbean sea. A serene escape perfect for two — where the ocean stretches endlessly in every direction. Saltwater pool access, and just minutes from beaches, dining, and town — yet a world apart.The spaceThe villa is a multi-level property designed to provide privacy for each unit. Montaña Rusa sits atop a beautifully landscaped one-acre lot with breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and surrounding greenery.A peaceful romantic retreat away from the busy city, where blue sky meets the ocean and green valleys frame the view below. Each level features an open terrace for taking in the scenery, watching birds pass at eye level, and dining al fresco.Start your morning with coffee on the terrace, listening to birdsong and feeling the gentle breeze. At sunset, unwind with a glass of wine, watching the sky change colors and rain form over the ocean. Fall asleep to the orchestra of jungle sounds.Inside, the space is open and intimate, featuring a custom mural by the architect. Glass sliding doors flood the room with natural light and frame uninterrupted ocean views. A cozy sitting area connects seamlessly to the kitchenette and out to the terrace — everything within reach, nothing in the way.The Space- Corner studio with wraparound terrace- Panoramic floor-to-ceiling ocean and valley views- Sitting area with corner sofa bed- Kitchenette- King bed with en-suite bathroom- Shared pool and outdoor kitchen area- Ceiling fans and natural cross-ventilationWell suited for a romantic getaway — slow mornings, long sunsets, and the kind of quiet that reminds you why you got away.Guest accessGuests have access to ground floor shared amenities, including a 35-foot saltwater pool, deck with lounge chairs, a full bathroom with washer and dryer, and an outdoor kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, sink, kitchen island, and poolside dining table.

title: Comfy and Quiet Beachy Bungalow

images.caption: The Bungalow has a full private bathroom.

description: The Beachy Bungalow is a cute, clean, and cold 1BR 1BA central to all that Rincon has to offer.🚶Located between the plaza and the marina, you can walk to coffee, breakfast, or organic food on your way to surf or snorkel in crystalline warm water. Then come home and relax to cool breezes and coqui frogs.🚫 Note: If the grid is down, we do not provide air conditioning.The spaceThis Bungalow has a beachy theme with clean lines, relaxing colors and a quiet atmosphere. While not on the beach, it's ideal for a single person or a couple wanting something centrally located to all Rincon has to offer. 🏝️ It's in a garden setting, on a quiet street just up from "Road to Happiness" Route 413 that leads to the best beaches in Rincon. 🚶Guests can easily walk to beaches at the Balneario or the Marina and enjoy snorkeling, sunning and swimming at both, or even surf fast hollow waves when the swell is right.🏡 Perfect for a no-hassle vacation, this apartment features a gated, walled yard, private entrance, a remodeled bathroom and a brand new kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, induction cooktop, coffeepot, blender, microwave and all the pots, pans, kitchen gadgets, dishes and silverware you'll need. 💦 We are sensibly environmentally conscious, so we collect rainwater and we've installed reverse osmosis water filters at all our guest accommodations: you don't have to lug expensive, heavy pallets of water in 32 individual plastic bottles. Plus ours tastes better than bottled. 🔋Most importantly for a stress-free vacation, this property is powered by a full solar generating system with Tesla Powerwall battery backup, and has rainwater collection and storage and a backup pump. If the power or water goes out, you'll probably not notice.😎 The unit is furnished with a queen bed in a cool quiet room behind blackout curtains that tame the Puerto Rican sun. The bedroom has a ceiling fan to move air, and a powerful mini-split AC in the main room. The Bungalow also has a small yard with patio and chairs for relaxing in the evening while listening to the coqui frogs sing.🌺 The Bungalow is in a garden setting with lovely plumeria and heliconia. If you get sunburned; we have a mature aloe vera plant as well. Just remember to let the latex (orange liquid) drain out first.♨️ The water pressure is great, and we have a solar hot water heater that, while saving the planet, gets hot enough to scald so please be aware. High speed WiFi is freely available.The Beach Bungalow is comfortable, peaceful, safe and secure, and a perfect retreat after a day charging waves, exploring the town, or just relaxing at the beach.Guest access🧺 Towels and linens are of course provided.🛜 Bring your laptop or tablet. The house has free 20 meg wifi for your convenience. There is a Roku TV on which you can log into your favorite streaming platforms, or enjoy the free entertainment provided.🤿 Guests often leave beach gear which is provided for your exclusive access on the patio. It often includes snorkel gear, coolers, chairs, though is not guaranteed, as it rotates depending on what recent guests have left behind, or recently broken. Feel free to use, and contribute for future guests! Please just rinse and return when done.Other things to note🏄‍♂️ Many people come here for the surf, which is world-class. The Bungalow is located less than two miles from Domes, with Maria's, Pistons, Dogman's, Tres Palmas and Steps even closer. 🤿 Steps is a terrific place to hang out and snorkel, and there are terrific scuba diving charters that run to Desecheo and Mona islands. You can find those at the marina just a half-mile away.🍻 Downtown, with bars, restaurants, shops and a brewery is less than a mile away. Everyone comes out for the Art Walk in the town square on Thursday nights, and for the Farmers Market on Sunday in the same location.

description: Experience tropical living in a unique A-frame villa, located only minutes away from Almendro’s Beach. Pepe’s Village offers a unique living environment in a comfortable and luxurious space. We take pride in providing a private area where our guests can feel free to emerge themselves into nature. Each villa has a secluded and fenced outdoor living space with a refreshing pool for the enjoyment of our guests.The spaceFirst Floor: As you go through the main entrance of Pepe’s Village you’ll see a wide living space. Here you’ll find a full kitchen, dinning room, living room and a full bathroom. Across the room, light enters the area through glass sliding doors which lead to the outdoor space. In this area you’ll have access to a 4’ deep pool, barbecue grill and outdoor furniture. Second Floor: When you reach the top of a spiral staircase you’ll see two bedrooms. To your right hand side you’ll find a smaller bedroom, which has one full sized bed and a twin sized bed. In the other side, you’ll see the master bedroom. This room has a king sized bed, a hammock chair, and a balcony with a view to the pool area. Both rooms have a/c, and are supplied with bed sheets and pillows.

title: Casa Del Gallo: Picturesque w/ Ocean Views & Pool
description: Casa Del Gallo is a tropical paradise in the heart of Puntas, Rincón. This Spanish-style 5BR/4BA home features ocean views, a private pool, gazebo, and stylish décor. Located in a quiet neighborhood just up the hill from Sandy Beach, you can walk to restaurants, bars, food trucks, and shops. Fully A/C with WiFi, Smart TV, stocked kitchen, linens, towels, BBQ grill, games, and parking for four cars.The spaceThis newly renovated home feels like stepping out of reality and into the pages of a vacation magazine. This stylish and unique 4BR/3BA retreat features vibrant local art, thoughtful design touches, and a seamless indoor-outdoor layout perfect for groups.The single-story property is divided into three sections.In the main house, the open-air kitchen and dining area flow into a spacious great room with high ceilings, ocean peek-a-boo views, plenty of seating, a 50" Smart TV, games, books, and a dedicated workspace for guests who may need to open a laptop while on vacation.Beyond the kitchen, the large wraparound porch offers an additional outdoor dining table, BBQ grill, and a stylish outdoor living area overlooking the pool and gazebo. One direction offers ocean views; the other surrounds you with mature palm trees and lush tropical gardens.Room 5 is newly built and fiurnished with a stand alone buiilding with a king bed, 50" smart tv, AC, a private covered terrace and an open air bathroom. The main house includes two bedrooms—one with a full bed and one with a queen—sharing a bathroom.The back section of the home features two private suites: one with a king bed and one with a queen. Each suite includes its own bathroom and a private patio with seating, ideal for quiet moments away from the group.The pool is perfect for a refreshing dip beneath the Caribbean sun. While compact, it provides the perfect place to cool off. Beside the pool, the gazebo offers two daybeds—ideal for afternoon naps, reading, or unplugging.This property sleeps a maximum of 10 guests.Guest accessGuests have full access to the property except for a small storage closet on the exterior of the building for Room 5. There is also a locked owner's closet in Bedroom 1.Other things to notePlease note: The house has three sections, and you’ll need to walk outside on the deck to access the two back bedrooms and Room 5 is a stand alone building just off the main porch.We live in the tropics, and the natural environment is part of the experience. You may hear coquí frogs at night, waves, roosters, dogs, and birds. If you prefer quiet, simply close the windows and use the A/C to minimize outside sounds.We reserve the right to cancel or limit bookings during holiday weeks/weekends (3–5 nights). Exceptions may apply.We are located on the western point of the island—2.5 hrs from SJU, 35 mins from BQN & MAZ, and 1.5 hrs from PSE. To avoid the drive from San Juan, Cape Air offers multiple daily flights from SJU to MAZ.

description: Bienvenidos to Ojalá!Featuring breathtaking views from virtually every room, Ojalá is located in the highly desirable Puntas neighborhood, just a short walking distance from many of Rincon's world-famous beaches and restaurants. Venture inside this brand-new modern private oasis where you will find luxurious design, decor, and amenities sure to make this a once-in-a-lifetime retreat. Ojalá is located just a few miles away from Downtown Rincon. Just follow the "Road to Happiness."The spaceOjala's unique floorplan features three bedrooms and two baths on the first floor and one bedroom and a full bath on the second floor. In addition, the second floor has an open-concept entertainment area and kitchen, which offers indoor-outdoor living when the weather accommodates. On the third level is a terrace with stunning ocean views of Aguadilla Bay.Ojalá wants all guests to enjoy their stay while being safe. We implore our guests to dry their feet and selves when entering the home from our saltwater pool (not heated) or ocean. Water can create a slip hazard; the floors will be slippery when wet. The water heater is high-efficiency and tankless. Allow a few moments for it to get warm.Rincón is a unique pueblo in that it provides a special setting: coastal and agricultural. Ojalá is located in the picturesque neighborhood of Puntas. Our friendly neighbors have horses, rosters, and dogs, to name a few. They are not just pets; they are family. We ask all our guests to be respectful; Ojalá is in a residential neighborhood. That's one of the reasons she is so unique - you’re holidaying among the locals.Please read: Ojalá is environmentally conscious, and we have pledged to minimize our carbon footprint. Our guests will power down the mini splits whenever the room is unoccupied. It takes only a few minutes to cool the room when they are powered on. This is strictly monitored via Tesla App. Repeated violations of this policy can result in immediate eviction from the property with no refund. We appreciate your effort in helping us care for our planet; after all, we only have one.Guest accessOjalá Luxury Villa — Guest AccessBefore arrival, guests must review, sign, and return the property’s liability waiver.
